capabilities: Publish the current note to Paper Studio via a command
Upload local images referenced in the note (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG)
Convert Markdown to styled HTML using brand settings from paperstudio.ink
Copy the shareable link to the clipboard
Configure API key and self-hosted server URL in settings
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. Manual installation requires building the plugin and copying files into the vault. Brand styling is configured on the Paper Studio website, not in the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-command way to turn a note into a branded, shareable HTML document hosted outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Publish your Obsidian notes to Paper Studio and get beautiful, shareable HTML documents.

summary: Publishing plugin that sends notes to the Paper Studio web service and returns a shareable styled HTML link.
